marketing_description: The Makita GSL02M1 Double Bevel Sliding Miter Saw features a 40V max XGT brushless motor, a 8-1/2 in. blade diameter, and a 5/8 in. arbor size. It also includes a double bevel design, rail-forward design, and electric brake for increased operator safety. This saw is compatible with AWS capability for wireless power-on with dust extractor.
